title: Chin Strap To Pass by Dom Bell
whyUseful: Dom Bell explains how to use the chin strap as a control handle to dictate the opponent's posture and create passing opportunities. Covers grip mechanics, pressure direction, and how to combine chin strap with knee cuts.

title: Chin Strap Basics by Dante Leon
whyUseful: Dante Leon breaks down the foundational mechanics of the chin strap, teaching how to use it to secure control in various no-gi positions including side control, turtle, and during passing sequences.
